MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MAY 8, 2025
  4900 E. 7TH STREET
  RECREATION PARK COMMUNITY CENTER, 2:30 PM

Jo Murray, Chair  Gordana Kajer, Commissioner
Bruce Mac Rae, Vice Chair  Elizabeth Lambe, Commissioner
Avis Atkins McPhail, Commissioner  Theresa Marino, Commissioner
Robert Blair, Commissioner  Sabrina Zavala, Commissioner
Elizabeth Carlin, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  TAMALYN.SAYRE@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55101  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Marine Advisory Commission
  meeting of Thursday, April 10, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-55211  Recommendation to receive and file an update on Refunding of the 2015 Marina
  Revenue Bonds, results of the bond sale – Financial Management.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-55102  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on Downtown Shoreline Vision
  Plan, Draft Vision Concept – Community Development.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-55103  Recommendation to approve the placement of a memorial bench to replace an
  existing standard bench in Marine Stadium to honor Laura Geraci Malloy. (District
  3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-55105  Recommendation to approve for submission to City Council the Marine Advisory
  Commission 2024 Annual Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-55106  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MAY 8, 2025
  4900 E. 7TH STREET
  RECREATION PARK COMMUNITY CENTER, 2:30 PM

7.  25-55107  Recommendation to receive and file the Committee reports.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Marine Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamalyn Sayre, Bureau Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Marine Bureau at (562) 570-3215 by noon the
day prior to the meeting.
